site.title: The Goumble | Javier Andres Vargas, Software Engineer

profile.name: Javier Andres Vargas
bio: I'm a full-stack software engineer based in South Florida with a B.A. in Computer Science and a minor in Cybersecurity from Florida Atlantic University.

I like building the parts people don't see: APIs, real-time networking, and secure systems, from a Spring Boot streaming backend with per-session AES-256 encryption to a multiplayer game that pairs a cloud-hosted Express API with peer-to-peer TCP sockets.
Outside of work you'll find me at game jams and hackathons, tinkering with my own tech, growing an endless music library, and messing with art.

projects.name: Secure Streaming Platform
projects.description: Educational live video streaming platform with real-time chat. Video frames are encrypted client-side with unique per-session AES-256 keys (Web Crypto API) and relayed through a Java Spring Boot backend over WebSockets. Built with React and Spring Boot.

projects.name: Multiplayer Blackjack
projects.description: JavaFX blackjack game with single-player vs. dealer AI and 1–4 player online multiplayer via game codes. Hybrid networking: an Express.js API on Google Cloud Run handles matchmaking and lobbies, while direct Java TCP peer-to-peer sockets handle live gameplay. Built with Java, JavaFX, Node.js, and Express.

projects.name: PeerSphere
projects.description: Desktop app that helps college students form study groups, share notes, build flashcards, and organize review sessions. Electron + JavaScript client backed by a Java service layer (models, DAOs, services) on MySQL 8.

projects.name: Meta Beanie
projects.description: Community platform where gamers discuss strategies. React and Bootstrap front end deployed on Firebase, with an Express + Node.js API backed by MongoDB.

projects.name: GMTK Game Jam 2023
projects.description: Game built under a tight deadline for the 2023 GMTK Game Jam.
